message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: unit tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install Ubuntu dependencies
        run: sudo apt update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install gettext appstream pkg-config libcairo2-dev gir1.2-gtk-3.0 libgirepository1.0-dev libicu-dev gir1.2-pango-1.0
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel setuptools
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
          pip install .[ai,face]
      - name: Run type checker
        run: mypy --install-types --non-interactive --ignore-missing-imports --exclude build .

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.15"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Free up disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
          sudo rm -rf /opt/ghc
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/share/boost
          sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY"
          sudo apt-get clean
          df -h
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install Ubuntu dependencies
        run: sudo apt update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install gettext appstream pkg-config libcairo2-dev gir1.2-gtk-3.0 libgirepository1.0-dev libicu-dev tesseract-ocr gir1.2-pango-1.0 poppler-utils
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel setuptools
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
          pip install .[ai,face]
          pip list
      - name: Clean up package caches
        run: |
          sudo apt-get clean
          pip cache purge
          df -h
      - name: Check for single alembic head
        run: |
          HEAD_COUNT=$(alembic heads | wc -l)
          if [ "$HEAD_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Multiple alembic heads detected! Run 'alembic heads' to inspect."
            alembic heads
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Test with pytest
        # loadfile keeps the tests of a module, and its fixtures, on one worker
        run: pytest -n auto --dist loadfile

  test-base-image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    container: ghcr.io/gramps-project/gramps-web-base:latest
    services:
      # used by tests/test_shared_postgresql.py
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: gramps
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: gramps
          POSTGRES_DB: gramps
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Install package
        run: pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements-dev.txt && pip install --no-cache-dir .[ai]
      - name: Test with pytest
        env:
          GRAMPSWEB_TEST_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://gramps:gramps@postgres:5432/gramps
        # the base image ships the SharedPostgreSQL addon
        run: GRAMPSWEB_TEST_ADDONS_DIR=/root/gramps/gramps$GRAMPS_VERSION/plugins pytest -n auto --dist loadfile",
  "rationale": "Add a pip dependency cache (actions/cache@v4) to the typecheck job, restoring ~/.cache/pip keyed on pyproject.toml before installing Python dependencies. The repository is a Python project (pyproject.toml present) that installs dependencies with pip in CI, matching the measured P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE experiment on a Python test workflow (~9% elapsed savings). The change only caches downloads; all install, typecheck, and test steps are preserved unchanged. The build job is intentionally not cached because its later 'pip cache purge' step would empty the cache before the job-level save, and the containerized test-base-image uses --no-cache-dir, so caching there would be ineffective.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
